Zero-copy vote account state access, voter records, and tower vote helpers.

# Purpose
Defines the `fd_voter` API and data layouts for reading vote account state from on-chain storage. It provides packed C structs and zero-copy serde views for the supported vote state versions, including `FD_VOTER_STATE_V0_23_5`, `FD_VOTER_STATE_V1_14_11`, and `FD_VOTER_STATE_CURRENT`, so code can inspect serialized vote account bytes without full deserialization. The file also defines the `fd_voter_t` record used by choreo code to track voter stake and cached vote records, plus helper functions such as [`fd_voter_state_cnt`](<#fd_voter_state_cnt>), [`fd_voter_state_vote`](<#fd_voter_state_vote>), and [`fd_voter_root_slot`](<#fd_voter_root_slot>) for reading tower data and the root slot.
